title: Marcus Antonius Primus
lead: The general of the Danube legions who led the Flavianist invasion of Italy in AD 69 and won the second battle at Bedriacum for Vespasian. Tacitus praises his skill in action and blames him for the sack of Cremona and for what he did after it.

sections.b: Suetonius says he was born at Tolosa (Toulouse) in Gaul and in his youth bore the nickname Becco, "a rooster's beak" (Vitellius 18). Tacitus says he had been convicted of forgery under Nero, regained his senatorial rank and was put over the 7th legion by Galba (2:86). Wikipedia says the charge was forging a will, that he was banished, and that Galba gave him the 13th legion in Pannonia. The Senate gave him the rank of a consul in December 69, and he left Rome when Mucianus came. Four of Martial's epigrams are addressed to him (Wikipedia).
